experiment.stop_condition: Stop if no eligible Amazon seller downloads it across all 10 exposure units, or if execution requires seller-side inputs beyond one product listing.
experiment.stop_reason: Capafy forbids changing an already-online Agent from run-online to Download; the experiment moved to a separate buyer-run Download product without changing the live Agent.
experiment.success_metric: At least one eligible Amazon seller downloads the bounded deliverable across the 10-unit exposure scenario.

incident.summary: Capafy publish-init rejected the new renewal-gated X KOL Tracker — Weekly Narrative Read with: /agent/agents/addAgent platform returned an error: A maximum of 5 unlisted agents is allowed. No new agent_id or review URL was created.
